chunks: From Muhammad ibn Muslim, he said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: A believer does not pass forty nights except that a matter befalls him that grieves him and reminds him (of Allah).
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of forty nights in a believer's life according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) states that it is characteristic of a believer to experience affliction or grief within every forty-night period. These trials serve as a reminder of Allah, highlighting the spiritual significance of hardship in the believer's life.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 30. It has been narrated that Muhammad ibn Muslim said:
I heard Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) saying: No forty nights pass for a believer except a matter befalls him that grieves him and reminds him (of Allah).
